epoch_candidate_freeze.reason: Section 8 licenses candidate maturation observables only if some family passes GM1-GM10; no family does (nearest: F1, first failure GM4). The F1 field family (level occupancy, |X|, E(X), poset invariants, C2 orbits) is inventoried above as the natural generic-construction pool but is NOT frozen as an epoch-candidate family and no threshold, partition, or basin is proposed.
